author: Pigbeard_Pete
body:
Hi!

I'm really excited to see Avicus start working on their tournament actively, and the scrim servers and team page are a wonderful addition to the competitive system. The ability to practice with your team and easily be able to schedule scrims and such on a reliable server is such a useful thing that will really enrich the tournament experience. I do have a few suggestions for how they can be run better, however.

1. Commands
As of now, only team leaders can use commands, which I get because your trying to limit the amount of unnecessary use of commands and empowerment of unchecked players on your servers. It's a smart idea, but it can get very annoying. Say you want to schedule a scrim with another team and you've reserved a server, and none of your team leaders are on. What then? I suggest giving perms to all players on a team. Trust that the team leaders will keep their members in order, and if they don't, can't, or won't deal out punishments and/or prohibit that team from using the scrim servers. It's much more useful for all players to be able to use commands because they don't need to rely on the team leader for assistance and they can try out their own things independently without the leaders constantly having to change gamemode for them. Also, expand the amount of commands each person gets. /heal, /fly, /gm, /tp, /end, /start, /sn, and /kick are some very simple, harmless commands that will allow for greater experimentation and freedom on scrim servers.

2. NCP
I'm not going to give away any tactics that our team uses, but a very popular TNT cannon on other servers (mainly OCN) is a cannon called an icarus. The basic idea is that you use TNT to launch yourself across the void gap. One version of this is called a Claf Icarus and is very powerful and great at its job. The only problem is, on Avicus the NCP stops you from using this cannon and others like it. 99250 and I were testing out this cannon today on the scrim servers, and every time I tried to use this cannon, we would NCP back and he would get spammed with console reports (it even reported him to himself XD). Although these types of cannons are not widely used on Avicus as there are currently very little maps with TNT in the rotations, but many of the maps on the scrim servers and, I'm assuming, tournament will have TNT capabilities. Cannons like this are possible to be made with great ease and are very useful in competitive situations, but the NCP prohibits us from using this to enrich our matches. I suggest removing NCP in terms of speed and fly hacking on scrim servers because it would unlock possibilities like these for our tournaments. The NCP for speed and fly is unnecessary, mostly because players can easily spot a fly or speed hacker and either record or report to get that player punished. Removing NCP from the scrim servers will not be detrimental in anyway to the server or its players.

3. Random Stuff
Here is some other stuff that doesn't necessarily pertain to just the scrim servers. TNT mechanics are very specific when it comes to the way they fire, and the current orientation of many maps messes with these mechanics. When firing cannons today on Ruby Jungle, I found that my shots went in crazy directions, not what I'm used to. That's because the orientation of Ruby Jungle (east to west) is the opposite way that TNT naturally wants to move, causing many cannons to fire oddly. A simple change with world edit to rotate 90 degrees until the map is facing north-south will easily fix this problem.

Thanks for looking at this, any mods, developers, or event coordinators! And you too regular Avicus players! I hope you can consider my suggestions for the enrichment of this server, I may be adding to this later if I have anything else.
